title: The Name Gets the Check
the_thought: The cash is a fee for the name. The big number is a guess about the stuff.
hook: A clerk drops a fat magazine next to a thin license invoice.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Forbes guessed about 6.5 billion dollars in March 2026. That guess is stuff minus debts, not a paycheck. Developers pay to stamp a name on towers they finance and build themselves. The family company collects a fee for the plate. CNBC added about 60 million dollars of 2025 foreign name fees from the ethics form. The public ticker sold about 4 million dollars of stuff that year. The cash is a fee for the name. The big number is a guess about the stuff.
